answer: Each identity binds one degree: its hash and the registrar signature enter the Willow Registry, with a 30 POA bond locked 90 days. The bond doubles per extra degree per cluster (30/60/120 POA, capped at 960), so 100 fakes lock 92,130 POA and need 100 degrees earned over 3 years; forged diplomas land on the Hollow List and forfeit the bond. The registrar re-attests each degree every epoch within 72 hours, and a random 5% re-check freezes payouts 3 epochs and forfeits half the bond. Two genuine degrees from one holder need 180 days plus double bond, so the Ocean Index stays the only gate.
